title: Coral and the Parish
author: Mirabel Amberdale
blurb: Ivo Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
